_doc: Every LCSC part of one half. scripts/parts/import_lcsc.py --manifest hardware/parts.json builds hardware/parts/<LCSC>/; scripts/parts/bom_check.py checks stock. Quantities are per half. Fixups are in the footprint's own front-side coordinates (before the bottom-side flip) and cite their datasheet.

parts.pin_names_source: E73-2G4M08S1C datasheet pp.6-7 pin table (module pin -> nRF52840 ball/function); AIx pins named by GPIO: AIN0..7 = P0.02, P0.03, P0.04, P0.05, P0.28, P0.29, P0.30, P0.31. Pin 26 RST = P0.18/RESET, 41/43 NF1/NF2 = P0.09/P0.10 (NFC), 11/13 XL1/XL2 = P0.00/P0.01.

model.source: STEP body is centred (13 x 18 mm); the footprint origin is 1.985 mm from the body centre. Checked by exporting STEP: body spans y 39.85-57.85 on the left half, matching the courtyard.

parts.role: Li-ion charger with power path (TI BQ24073RGTR)

fixups.source: docs/datasheets/C15220_BQ24073RGTR.pdf p.41, 'Example Stencil Design': 68% solder coverage on the 1.7 mm centre pad. The exposed pad's (17) paste aperture is shrunk 0.15 mm per side to 1.40 x 1.40 mm, 68% of the pad; EasyEDA's footprint pastes 100%, which can float a 0.5 mm-pitch QFN (phases 4-6 second review L2).

model.source: Moves the receptacle's front face onto the courtyard front (local y -5.09, the drawing's 6.27 mm from the locating pegs). Checked in an exported STEP.

fixups.source: Pin-in-paste for the four through-hole shell legs (pads 1-4): JLC's footprint has no paste on them, so reflow wouldn't solder them and the receptacle would hang on its 12 small SMD pads (phase 4-6 review M3).

parts.role: USB D+/D- and VBUS ESD protection (ST USBLC6-2SC6)
parts.pin_names_source: ST USBLC6-2 datasheet, pin configuration: 1/6 I/O1, 2 GND, 3/4 I/O2, 5 VBUS

parts.role: Schottky diodes: USB VBUS and dock 5V into the charger input (D1, D2), CHG/PGOOD sense into GPIOs (D4, D5) (1N5819WS, SOD-323)
parts.pin_names_source: 1N5819WS datasheet p.1: SOD-323, cathode at the band ('-'); checked against the footprint's silkscreen bar

parts.role: TVS on the exposed dock 5V pad (SMF6.0A: 6.0 V standoff covers USB's 5.25 V)
power slide switch between charger OUT and VDDH (MSK12C02)
parts.pin_names_source: MSK12C02 drawing: 2 is the common terminal, 1 and 3 the throws, 4 the shell tabs

model.source: Moves the lever tip onto the courtyard's lever end. Checked in an exported STEP.

parts.role: reverse-mount RGB LEDs, common anode: status (GPIO) and charge (CHG/PGOOD) (MHT151RGBCT)

fixups.source: docs/datasheets/C409782_MHT151RGBCT.pdf p.2: the lens is 1.4 x 1.25 mm (diagonal 1.88 mm), and 'Recommended Solder Pad (Reverse Type)' has a 2.1 mm hole and 0.8 x 0.7 mm pads 2.3 mm apart, which puts the pad corners 0.12 mm from the hole. The hole is the datasheet's 2.1 mm; the pads sit 0.15 mm further out (centres at x +-1.70) so they keep 0.265 mm from the hole (JLC hole-to-copper 0.25 mm) and still overlap the LED's end terminals by 0.3 mm (phases 4-6 second review M3; the earlier 1.8 mm hole left the lens diagonal no room). EasyEDA's footprint has the pads closer together and no hole.

parts.pin_names_source: MHT151RGBCT datasheet p.2 polarity: 1 common anode, 2 blue, 3 green, 4 red (EasyEDA names all three cathodes 'neg', which would short them)

model.source: Reverse mount: the body hangs below the board with the lens up into the hole (EasyEDA's model is normal-mount). Checked in an exported STEP: body z -1.09..0.

parts.role: 10k: charger TS (no thermistor); VBUS pull-down (holds VBUS low against D1's reverse leakage when docked)
5.1k: USB-C CC1, CC2; charger ILIM, ISET
220R: status LED green and blue (higher forward voltage than red)
4.7uF 10V 0402: VDD, the module regulator's output (the E73 datasheet doesn't say the module carries the nRF52840's 4.7 uF REG0 capacitor itself; phases 4-6 second review L3)
1uF 50V 0603: charger IN (sees up to 26 V on overvoltage)
10uF 10V 0603: VDDH bulk, charger OUT and BAT (4.7 uF minimum after DC bias at 4.4 V)
